portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied, and that you are running Red Hat Advanced Cluster Management for Kubernetes 2.13.2.

Important: This hotfix is a temporary fix that will be supported until 30 days after the date when the next z-stream version of the product is released. After the 30-day period ends, you must upgrade to the latest version of the product to request support.

Contact your CEE for assistance with installing this hotfix.

To workaround the issue of your application resources getting deleted, add `spec.syncPolicy.applicationsSync: create-update` to the `ApplicationSet` resource.
portal_description:
Red Hat Advanced Cluster Management 2.13.2 hotfix for multicloud-integrations

When you use the application sets and when the ArgoCD cluster secret is invalid, application resources created by the application set gets deleted. 

Bug addressed:

Gitops Server reports "Failed to load target state" (ACM-19579)
